responsibility: Implements GCC’s main compiler driver: the top-level orchestration layer that interprets user options and specs, builds language- and target-specific subprocess command lines, manages temporary files and search prefixes, coordinates preprocessing/compilation/assembly/link stages, and exposes reusable driver APIs through the driver class. In addition to the spec engine and path/environment management, this file owns reinitialization/finalization support for in-process reuse, environment restoration, configure-time option expansion for clients such as libgccjit, and the central state that distinguishes the generic driver core from the tiny gcc-main entry stub.
same_name_distinction: This is the driver-core implementation file in the gcc pair: it contains the actual compiler-driver machinery, including environment management, spec processing, path handling, subprocess orchestration, and in-process finalize/reset support. Unlike gcc/gcc.h, it does not merely declare the driver class and exported hooks; it implements the reusable GCC driver behavior.
